essence: Longing to see the deep and dwell in the cave; homage to dream-seers of the bliss-giver.
Desire to contemplate being cuts rebirth-fear; lifelong single-pointed staying resolved.
Veda-bodied wish-tree bowed; entrusting all acts to become you-made and pair-free.
Independent trident power in all cosmic tasks; Dhūrjaṭi's name outdoes meditations.
Mantra refuge praised; every path, word, meditation is the Lord.

sections.SUMMARY: The deep calls to be seen and dwelt in; those who glimpse the moon-crested even asleep earn homage. Hunger to brood on being severs rebirth dread; lifelong one-pointedness is vowed. The Veda-bodied granter bends low; handing over deed, speech, mind, the lover turns you-stuffed and quarrel-free. Alone-working spear-power orders birth and close; one Name outweighs all props. Mantra-sheltered strivers win praise; road, utterance, trance alike end in the Lord.

rasa.dominant: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)
rasa.justification: Hunger to see and stay (deep, cave, tree, name) settling into praise; longing fixed one-pointed.
